observations.code_quote: The `next_push_likely` chance comes from a table fitted offline on closed PRs and refitted by hand. Its key is the follow-up number, capped at 8, and the PR size band (additions plus deletions: up to 200, up to 1000, more). A size cell with fewer than 10 PRs falls back to the chance for the follow-up number alone. The follow-up number is `run_index - 1`, so it also counts comment and UI turns, which the fit left out.
